subtitle: Lesson 30 · Capstone: Running a Real Application on Kubernetes

code:
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: order-api
spec:
  ingressClassName: nginx
  rules:
    - host: orders.harrowcreek.dev
      http:
        paths:
          - path: /
            pathType: Prefix
            backend:
              service:
                name: order-api
                port: { number: 80 }
caption: The Ingress routes to the Service built in Lesson 29 -- it doesn't replace it.

code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
metadata:
  name: order-worker-data
spec:
  accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
  storageClassName: standard-rwo
  resources:
    requests:
      storage: 5Gi
caption: storageClassName triggers dynamic provisioning -- nobody pre-creates the PersistentVolume by hand.

code:
# templates/api-deployment.yaml (excerpt)
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.api.replicaCount }}
  containers:
    - image: "{{ .Values.api.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.api.image.tag }}"

# values.yaml
api:
  replicaCount: 3
  image: { repository: registry.harrowcreek.dev/order-api, tag: "1.0.0" }
worker:
  replicaCount: 2
  storage: { size: 5Gi }
caption: helm create order-app, then every object's hard-coded values move into one values.yaml.
